model.name: Dir-namespace single base-resolution — ALL dir: refs repo-relative, ONE resolveDirRefAbs, retire the 2 correct-by-incident special-cases (gated migration of dead lazy dir: units)
model.description: DIR-NAMESPACE SINGLE BASE-RESOLUTION (correct-by-construction follow-up, architect design 71e7c87ab, PO-dispatched to expert). ROOT (measured): the dir: ref namespace carries TWO base conventions - sourceDirTree emits SRC-relative dir:<childRel> (walk=PROJECT_ROOT/src/rel), pumlPhysicalTree emits REPO-relative dir:<dirRel> - while file: refs are ALREADY repo-relative. So dir: is the outlier, and TWO correct-by-INCIDENT special-cases paper over it: the createPhysicalWithUnit existence-heuristic (FolderService:65-66, pinned as a deadline measure) and the puml-dir regex (server.ts:1706). This is the SAME root behind the Tron-facing Add-folder-on-/model bug (dir:ts location=src-relative -> mkdir PROJECT_ROOT/ts -> ENOENT) AND the P5 sourceDirTree base gap. FIX (remove the ambiguity, don't heuristically resolve it): make ALL dir: refs REPO-RELATIVE (one convention, aligned with file:), so ONE shared resolveDirRefAbs(ref)=path.resolve(PROJECT_ROOT, ref-without-dir-prefix) is a trivial join with NO discrimination and NO heuristic; retire both special-cases.

model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED — NEW follow-up (post-QA correctness-by-construction cleanup, NOT blocking T37.21 QA-Review); scenario-first #126; architect mints Class+Method(resolveDirRefAbs)+Impl; build per PO sequencing; 0 Done till Tron.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ALL dir: refs are REPO-RELATIVE (one convention, aligned with the existing file: convention). sourceDirTree emits dir:src/<childRel> (was dir:<childRel>); no ref carries a SRC-relative base. Two dir: base conventions => the defect this eliminates.

There is ONE resolver: resolveDirRefAbs(ref) = path.resolve(PROJECT_ROOT, ref.replace(/^dir:/,'')) -> the absolute disk path (abs-string only, NO {abs,baseKind} - baseKind is ELIMINATED because there is ONE base=PROJECT_ROOT). Every dir:->abs consumer (createPhysicalWithUnit, sourceDirTree walk, ensureViewUnit location) routes through it; empty/invalid -> '' and the caller confines.

The two correct-by-INCIDENT special-cases are RETIRED: (a) the createPhysicalWithUnit existence-heuristic (FolderService:65-66, the pinned deadline measure) and (b) the puml-dir base regex (server.ts:1706). Resolution is correct-by-CONSTRUCTION (one convention + one resolver), never correct-by-fallback. stub: any dir-base resolution NOT through resolveDirRefAbs (a surviving heuristic/special-case) => RED.

The dir:ts->dir:src/ts change moves keyToUuid('folder::ts')->keyToUuid('folder::src/ts') = the LAZY Folder unit identity; old uuids become DEAD MODEL_STORE view-units (dir: folders are lazy, re-minted on access). A GATED sweep removes the orphaned dir: units: DRY-RUN + COUNT first (before==after accounting), never a blind delete. No ACTIVE data loss (only re-mintable lazy view-units are touched).

The migration touches ONLY lazy, re-mintable dir: view-units (dead uuids), NEVER active data; confinement (createPhysicalWithUnit) is unchanged. stub: a sweep that removes a NON-lazy / referenced unit => RED.

stub-must-fail: (1) a dir: ref emitted SRC-relative (dir:ts not dir:src/ts) => RED; (2) a dir->abs path computed by a heuristic/special-case instead of resolveDirRefAbs => RED; (3) the migration sweep run without a dry-run+count => RED.

★ The dead-lazy-dir-unit migration is GATED in BOTH DIRECTIONS (PO 2026-09-01 — this is the one part of the change that touches EXISTING data, not new behaviour; a resolver change that quietly re-points units is discovered much later). (A) NOTHING LOST: the sweep removes ONLY UNREFERENCED lazy dir: units; a before==after count reconciles (swept == orphaned-lazy, 0 referenced/active units removed); a sweep that would delete a referenced/non-lazy unit => RED. (B) NOTHING WRONGLY RE-POINTED: every dir: ref whose base convention changes (dir:ts -> dir:src/ts) resolves to the CORRECT new lazy-unit identity keyToUuid('folder::'+repo-rel), and a REVERSE check confirms every consumer of a re-pointed dir: unit now resolves to the new unit — NO ref left dangling on a dead old uuid, NO ref re-pointed to a WRONG uuid. stub-must-fail: (i) a referenced unit swept => RED; (ii) a dir: ref left on a dead old uuid after migration => RED; (iii) a dir: ref re-pointed to a uuid != keyToUuid(new-repo-rel-key) => RED. Same both-sides discipline as R37.29 referential-integrity.
